test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The area of a square field is 7200 m². How long will a cycle take to cross the field diagonally at a constant rate of 4 km/h?
solution:
**Given**

area of a square field = 7200 m2

**Formula used**

Area of square = (side)²

Diagonal of square = √{(side)² + (side)²}

Time = Distance/speed

**Calculation**

Distance cover = √{7200 + 7200}

⇒ √14400

⇒ 120 m

Speed of cycle = 4 km/h

⇒ (4 × 1000)/60

⇒ 400/6

⇒ (200/3) m/min

Time taken by cycle to cover 120 m = 120/(200/3)

⇒ (120/1) × (3/200)

⇒ 360/200

⇒ 9/5 minutes

**∴ 9/5 minutes will a cycle take to cross the field diagonally at a constant rate of 4 km/h**
